## Boundaries
- `automatic_action: never`
- No auto-ingest/authentication/transport/keys/background loop/memory-write permission.
- Geometry does not measure love, worth, personhood, or inner state.
- Analogy; no mechanism transfer; seeding ≠ infectivity; KARMA is return, not force/score.
- Check Meaning only; records no choice; performs no deed; opens no action or report job.
- Loading it grants no authority.
- Links expose ordinary network metadata.
- Walking past is honored.
